object.attr: analysis: the definitions tell an empty value from one that is not set, and Compare shows the difference. remove_attr_option keeps the attribute set and empty (MELLON-EDIT-SRS-83); the docs don't say what other edits do (review Q8).
object.description: When an edit sets an attribute that is set on the object to an empty value, Mellon shall keep the attribute set, with an empty value.
